# Rumors

The same table in English, one card per row: the roll and the entry from
the columns the `table:` map names. The deck prints `de` and leaves it
out. The rumors are invented for this deck.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: dino-island
  card-type: roll-table
  language: en
table:
  roll: Roll
  description: Rumor
```

| Roll | Rumor |
| ---- | ----- |
| 1    | Compasses don't work on the island the way they should. |
| 2    | At night there's music from the complex — always the same song. |
| 3    | The pterosaurs avoid the eastern cliffs. Nobody knows why. |
| 4    | Whoever reaches the tower finds supplies for a week — so they say. |
